title: Stop accepts a deleted test whose imported source the branch deletes, whatever its name
body:
Outcome: the Stop hook accepts a deleted test when the branch deletes the source it covers even if the names differ: test/adopt/prune-unused.test.ts covered src/adopt/unused.ts (`krn adopt --prune-unused`), both deleted in #1135-era S28 step 1 (706c874), and Stop still refused "deleted test". Match by the test's imports of deleted modules (or the CLI flag it drives), not only by file stem.
Why: S28 lane 2026-11-16 ended in a BLOCKER line after a merged PR; #1130 (89ad66f) only matches same-stem sources.
Proof: a hook test deletes a source and a differently named test that imports it, and Stop exits 0.
